## Ontology terms

| term | definition | notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Compiled Bundle** | The sealed, content-addressed output of the compiler for one (sealed definition, profile chain, target set, compiler version): `{bundle_id, derivation_key, runtime_plan, model_surface, target_artefacts{}, trace_map, lcd_report, loss_reports{}, opacity_report, diagnostics[]}`; references no run-time value; the artefact an experiment's `configuration` id points at. | WS-A4 / WS-I3. Reproducible-builds discipline (S-WS-A4-06). |
| **derivation key** vs **bundle id** | *Derivation key* = hash of the canonical inputs (definition `version_id`, variant digests, profile hashes, target-spec versions, compiler version) — input address, used for caching and early cut-off. *Bundle id* = hash of the canonical outputs — content address, used for identity. Two compiler versions that emit identical bytes share a bundle id. | WS-A4 / WS-L4. Nix RFC 0062 pattern (S-WS-A4-07). |
| **Runtime Plan** | Stage-2 output: the executable-but-interpreted structures for the reference runtime — a closed set of plan-node kinds (loop, step, branch-on-validator, delegate, stop-rule), tool table (capability → executor binding + effect/permission/cost/risk classes), reference-monitor policy tables, budget envelope, context-policy parameters, validator bindings — every node carrying its `hir_node_id`. Never host-language code (OQ-043). | WS-A4 / WS-F1 / WS-H1. |
| **Model Surface** (static · transcript · protocol surface) | Stage-3 output under one profile: prompt layout (typed sections in profile-declared order with run-time slots), tool surfaces, interaction mode, sampling/caching parameters, compaction/reminder parameters, and the *transcript renderer spec*. The three surface kinds: **static surface** (compiled once), **transcript surface** (rendered per turn from the ledger under the renderer spec), **protocol surface** (what an external client/agent sees via MCP/ACP/A2A). | WS-A4 / WS-C3 / WS-D1. Extends ontology "surface". |
| **Surface Argument Map** | Per tool surface: `{surface_field → capability_param, transform, narrowing?}`; total (no unmapped surface field) and sound (no mapped value can reach a parameter outside its declared domain); the object the reference monitor evaluates `Permission` against. | WS-A4 / WS-E2 / WS-H1. Obligation E2. |
| **equivalence evidence** | The per-surface record `{E1..E7: pass \| fail \| n/a(reason)}` attached at stage 3 establishing that a compiled surface preserves its `ToolCapability`'s effects, authority, precondition domain, end-state behaviour (closed-world), error classes, validator-relevant result fields and accounting identity. `n/a` is never 0. | WS-A4 / WS-E2. Novel as an integrated contract. |
| **trace map** | `locator → {hir_node_ids[], rule_ids[], target_rule_ids[]}` over every model-facing token span and every emitted target field; total; the basis of attribution and of WS-B1's `rendering_ref`. | WS-A4 / WS-B1 / WS-I7. MLIR location-tracking pattern. |
| **closed-world rule** | No run-time operation may deliver to a model, or expose to an external system, an artefact that has no compiled identity in the bundle; run time *selects, fills, orders within declared layout, triggers* and *renders the transcript* — it never introduces surfaces. | WS-A4 / WS-D1 / WS-E3. Makes T-LCD-13 computable. |
| **re-lowering** | The one sanctioned run-time compilation: on a mid-run model-binding change the runtime calls `relower(bundle, new_profile)`, obtains a new bundle id, applies the new transcript renderer, and records `model.surface.relowered{old_bundle_id, new_bundle_id, old_profile_ref, new_profile_ref, dropped_items[], rewritten_items[]}`. The runtime plan is unchanged. | WS-A4 / WS-C2 / WS-B1. goose `thinking_block_is_stale` precedent. |
| **minimum carried set** | The HIR metadata a protocol target must carry through its typed extension slot for the export to keep `component`/`configuration` granularity: `{semantic_id + bundle_id, effects, permission class, provenance pointer, budget reference}`; a target that cannot carry it is admitted only at `product` granularity. | WS-A4 / WS-E4 / WS-K3. Keeps T-LCD-11 from degenerating. |
| **lowering loss class** | The closed classification of a loss-report entry: `no_slot` (target has no field), `hint_only` (carried as an untrusted hint), `untyped_slot` (carried in a free-form slot), `narrowed` (domain restricted, e.g. strict-schema subset), `truncated` (rendering shortened). Severity `info \| narrowed \| lost`. | WS-A4 / WS-E4. |
| **interaction mode** | The profile-owned choice of how a model invokes tools: `native_fc \| freeform (grammar/custom) \| shim (interpreter model extracts calls from text) \| code_mode (model-authored programs call tools)`; C0 admits `native_fc` only. | WS-A4 / WS-C3 / WS-E3. goose `toolshim.rs`, codex `tool_mode`. |
| **profile conformance probe** | A capability probe run against a live model adapter that turns a profile's `declared` capability values into `probed` ones and yields `ConformanceRecord{profile_version, capability, declared, probed, verdict, probe_run_id}`; `DRIFT` is experimental data, `unknown` is never coerced. | WS-A4 / WS-C3 / WS-I6. Mirrors ontology *observed conformance / drift* for hosted participants. |
| **ProfileRule** | A conditioned rule that lives in a Model Profile document: `{rule_id, kind ∈ closed enum, owned_fields[], params, debt: AssumptionDebtRecord}`; may write only *surface records*; sibling of the definition-level `HarnessRule` (CF-WS-A4-06). | WS-A4 / WS-C3. |
| **profile expiry state** | `active \| expiring \| expired \| retired` on a profile version, derived from its rules' debt records and probe results; compiling under `expired` requires an explicit recorded intent. | WS-A4 / WS-C3 / WS-I6. T-LCD-05 applied to the profile itself. |
